checks.explanation: D-selection is printed on page 1 and itemized prices begin on page 1, so it is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, authorizations and permits, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the basic services fee as overhead; no other mandatory facilities or staff fee is printed.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service; only the prescribed embalming disclosure appears.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation range $1,595 to $1,945 is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
No text states a casket is required for direct cremation; direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container and alternative containers.
Direct cremation includes removal, transportation and cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no other offered good or service lacks its own line.
The list contains only required single-price items like forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial, with no optional combination package.
No text asserts law, cemetery or crematory requires a purchase; only prescribed statements that embalming and outer containers are generally not required by law appear.
No text claims goods or services delay decomposition long-term or protect from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the disclosures are printed as clear statements.
